nominal_sequence: ur5e-1 or ur5e-2 places the completed peg horizontally on a reserved stopped Conveyor segment
Conveyor feeds the peg directly into empty reserved zone 1 of Buffer For Machined parts
Independent zones advance one peg at a time into an empty reserved downstream zone with acknowledged sensor feedback
Zone 4 stops; ur5e-3 picks the peg directly into assembly
Confirmed pickup, clear zone 4, and robot clearance permit the next advance
A full buffer applies backpressure to Conveyor; machine robots use their staging nests
Buffer For Machined parts.fault_behavior: stop affected zones and upstream delivery; preserve last confirmed part custody
